text: Mrs. Straker's account: one o'clock and seven o'clock
why: Mrs. Straker's account so far mentions only one in the morning; nothing about seven o'clock has been told yet.
The story says Straker pulled on his large mackintosh before leaving.
The catastrophe happened on Monday night, so one in the morning that night is plainly early Tuesday.

text: Why did Straker go out at one in the morning?
why: A plain question raised by Straker leaving the house at one in the morning.

text: Why did Straker go out at one in the morning? — to see that all was well
id: q.straker_aim=to see that all was well
why: Straker himself said he meant to walk down to the stables to see that all was well.
